title: Set 44

sentences.ko: 세 군데나 가 봤는데 다 자리가 꽉 차 있었어. 마지막 집에서는 결국 음료수 들고 서서 누가 일어나기만 기다리고 있었지. 드디어 한 자리가 비었는데 어떤 커플이 쓱 들어오더니 그냥 앉아 버리더라. 그래서 그냥 집에 왔어.
sentences.text: I tried three places and they were all packed, so at the last one I ended up standing there holding my drink waiting on somebody to leave, and then a table finally opened up and this couple walked right in and took it. So I just came home.

alts.text: Three places, all packed, and at the last one I'm just standing there holding my drink waiting for somebody to leave, and a table finally opens up and this couple walks right in and takes it. So I just came home.

I tried three places and all of them were full, so at the last one I found myself standing there holding my drink, waiting for someone to leave. A table finally became available, and then a couple walked straight in and took it. So I came home.

sentences.note: **packed** 는 사람이 꽉 들어차서 빈자리가 없다는 뜻입니다. **a table opened up** 은 자리 하나가 비었다는 말이고, **walked right in** 의 right 는 거리낌 없이 곧장이라는 느낌을 더해 줍니다.

sentences.ko: 아홉 시에 동생 데리러 가야 한다고 말할 거야. 그건 진짜로 사실이기도 하고. 근데 아니었어도 어차피 무슨 핑계든 만들어 냈을걸. 앉은 순간부터 갈 마음이었거든.
sentences.text: I'm going to tell them I've got to pick my sister up at nine, and that part is actually true, but I'd have come up with something either way. I've been ready to go since we sat down.

alts.text: Gonna tell them I have to pick up my sister at nine, and that part's actually true, but I'd have thought of something either way. I've been ready to go since we sat down.

I intend to tell them that I need to pick my sister up at nine, and that part is genuinely true, although I would have come up with something regardless. I have been ready to leave since the moment we sat down.

sentences.note: **come up with something** 은 둘러댈 구실을 하나 지어낸다는 뜻입니다. **either way** 는 이랬든 저랬든 결과는 같다는 말이고, **ready to go** 는 자리를 뜰 준비가 됐다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 보험료가 또 올랐어. 무슨 일이 있었던 것도 아니고 사고도 없었고 아무것도 없었는데. 그래서 왜 그러냐고 전화했더니 담당자가 그냥 요금이 전체적으로 올랐다고만 하더라. 그건 나도 알지. 그래도 누구 한 명쯤은 나랑 같이 놀라 주기라도 했으면 싶었어.
sentences.text: My insurance went up again and nothing even happened, no accidents, nothing, so I called to ask why, and the guy just said rates went up everywhere. Which I know, but I wanted somebody to at least act surprised with me.

alts.text: Insurance went up on me again and nothing even happened, no accidents, nothing, so I called to ask why, and the guy just goes rates went up everywhere. Which, yeah, I know, but I wanted somebody to at least act surprised with me.

My insurance premium increased again even though nothing occurred, no accidents, nothing at all, so I called to ask why, and the representative simply said that rates had risen everywhere. I am aware of that, but I wanted someone to at least act surprised along with me.

sentences.note: **went up** 은 값이 올랐다는 가장 흔한 표현입니다. **act surprised** 는 진짜 놀라라는 게 아니라 놀란 척이라도 해 달라는 뜻이고, 회화에서 **the guy just goes** 는 그 사람이 이러더라고 하며 말을 옮길 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 너는 새로운 거 보고 싶다고 계속 말하잖아. 근데 내가 고른 최근 네 개는 자막 있다고 다 싫다고 했잖아. 그럼 두 시간 동안 책을 읽든가 보던 거 다시 틀든가 둘 중 하나야. 솔직히 나는 어느 쪽이든 상관없어. 그냥 뭐라도 보고 있고 싶을 뿐이야.
sentences.text: You keep saying you want something new, but you've said no to the last four things because they had subtitles. So either we read for two hours or we put the same show back on, and honestly I'm fine with either one, I just want to actually be watching something.

alts.text: Okay, you want something new, you keep telling me that, but you've said no to the last four things because they had subtitles. So either we read for two hours or we put the same show back on, and honestly I'm good with either one, I just wanna actually be watching something.

You continue to say that you would like something new, yet you have declined the last four options because they had subtitles. So either we read for two hours or we put the same show back on, and frankly I am content with either one. I would simply like to actually be watching something.

sentences.note: **said no to** 는 제안을 거절했다는 말입니다. **put the same show back on** 은 보던 걸 다시 튼다는 뜻이고, **I'm fine with either one** 은 둘 중 아무거나 괜찮다는 흔한 대답입니다.

sentences.ko: 구석에 두려고 그 의자를 샀는데 사이트에서는 훨씬 작아 보였거든. 지금은 몸을 옆으로 틀어야 지나갈 수 있어. 반품할 수는 있는데 반송비를 내가 내야 해. 결국 내가 틀렸다고 인정하는 데 60달러를 쓰는 셈이지. 내일 다시 물어봐 줘.
sentences.text: I ordered that chair for the corner and it looked way smaller on the website, and now you have to turn sideways to get past it. I could send it back, but I'd have to pay the return shipping myself, so I'd be paying sixty bucks just to admit I was wrong. Ask me again tomorrow.

alts.text: That chair I got for the corner looked way smaller online, and now you've gotta turn sideways to get past it. I could send it back, but I'd be covering the return shipping myself, so that's sixty bucks just to admit I was wrong. Ask me again tomorrow.

I ordered that chair for the corner and it appeared considerably smaller on the website, and now one has to turn sideways to get past it. I could send it back, but I would have to pay the return shipping myself, so I would be paying sixty dollars merely to admit that I was wrong. Please ask me again tomorrow.

sentences.note: **turn sideways** 는 몸을 옆으로 돌려서 겨우 지나간다는 뜻입니다. **send it back** 은 반품하다, **Ask me again tomorrow** 는 지금은 결정 못 하겠으니 나중에 다시 물어보라는 말입니다.

reviewed: 1번 formal 의 walked directly in 은 원어민이 안 쓰는 조합이라 walked straight in 으로 고쳤고, I simply came home 도 어색해서 So I came home 으로 바꿨습니다.
2번 formal 의 collect my sister 는 영국식이라 다른 문장들의 미국식(bucks 등)과 안 맞습니다. pick my sister up 으로 고쳤습니다.
3번 formal 에서 My insurance increased 는 격식체로는 무엇이 올랐는지가 빠져 있어 My insurance premium increased 로 했습니다. 뜻은 그대로입니다.
4번 한국어의 '최근에 고른 네 개'는 상대가 고른 것처럼 읽혀 영어(내가 내민 것을 네가 거절했다)와 어긋납니다. '내가 고른 네 개는 다 싫다고 했잖아'로 고쳤습니다.
